t: The Power of the Downstate: Recharge Your Life Using Your Body's Own Restorative Systems: Mednick PhD, Sara C.: 9780306925795: Amazon.com: Books
s: Mednick creates a comprehensive picture of the Upstate/Downstate rhythms that orchestrate all of our bodies’ vital systems, along with a novel theory that aging is caused by spending less and less time in Downstate activities. The Power of the Downstate offers practical, evidence-based insight into how we can all enable those systems to work together in better harmony.
